title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 398 (Provisions relating to filing of applications, documents, inspection, etc., in electronic form)

content.overview: Applications, documents and inspections under the Act may be made or done in electronic form, in the manner the section and the rules provide.
content.glance: Applications, documents and inspections under the Act may be made or done in electronic form, in the manner the section and the rules provide.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 398 (Provisions relating to filing of applications, documents, inspection, etc., in electronic form). Applications, documents and inspections under the Act may be made or done in electronic form, in the manner the section and the rules provide. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: Applications, documents and inspections under the Act may be made or done in electronic form, in the manner the section and the rules provide.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Electronic filing is the ordinary mode. A document filed electronically, duly authenticated, has the same effect as a paper filing.
